description: a pattern matches every file below the workspace, in the order of a walk that enters each directory and takes its entries in the byte order of their names
`**` matches any number of directories, none among them
the walk enters a directory before it reaches a sibling whose name extends the directory's
a directory matches every file below it, and is not hashed itself
a pattern after `!` excludes what it matches, and the files below a directory it matches
a wildcard matches a name that starts with a dot
`?` matches one character
a class matches one character of a range
a class that starts with `!` matches one character outside it
a pattern within the directory of another is found by the walk of that other
patterns whose directories lie apart are walked in the order they are given
a file that two patterns match is hashed once
an argument holds a pattern on each line, without the white space around it, and a blank line or one that starts with `#` holds none
a pattern that ends with `/` matches the files below its directory
a leading `./` names the workspace
a second `!` takes back the first
patterns that only exclude match nothing, which hashes to the empty string
a pattern that matches nothing hashes to the empty string
`..` cannot be a part of a pattern
`.` can be a part of a pattern only at its start
